observable_from_event_data: CHSH value for a defined 2x2 binary setting scenario
Sampling uncertainty under a stated sampling model
not_directly_observable_without_addition: The causal direction of any setting-source dependence
Whether settings and source share a common past cause
Whether an observed dependence is fundamental or instrumental
observability_audit.important_distinction: A dataset may show statistically independent settings and still be compatible with hidden measurement dependence involving an unobserved variable. Conversely, a setting imbalance alone does not establish superdeterminism.
observability_audit.selection_bias_and_postselection: Detection-loophole and event-selection assumptions must be handled using the experiment's original protocol. A naive coincidence-only CHSH estimate may not reproduce the published loophole-free statistic.
observability_audit.NIST_warning: NIST explicitly notes that repository metadata may be incomplete and its software/data are supplied as-is.
